name: meowanalyze
description: A full-featured static code analyzer: language detection, cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth and more.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @meowanalyze/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @meowanalyze/desktop
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build --workspace @meowanalyze/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist --workspace @meowanalyze/desktop
